scenes.name: ALONE
lines: Alone, an observer checks itself by one rule: the next reading is the cosine of the last.
一位观察者独自省察自己，只有一条规则：下一个读数是上一个读数的余弦。
From zero point one, the readings jump across theta star, zero point seven three nine, and back again.
从 0.1 出发，读数越过 θ* ≈ 0.739，又跳回来。
The slope there is minus zero point six seven four, so every step flips the sign of the error.
那里的斜率是 −0.674：每走一步，误差就换一次符号。

scenes.name: TWO MIRRORS
lines: Now two observers read each other: A takes the cosine of B, and B the cosine of A.
现在两位观察者互相丈量：A 取 B 的余弦，B 取 A 的余弦。
Count two readings as one round. The round map is the cosine of the cosine, and its slope is positive.
两拍算一轮：一轮的映射是 cos(cos x)，它的斜率为正。
Round by round: zero point five four four, zero point six five six, zero point seven zero two, always from below.
Each round shrinks the error by about zero point four five four, the square of zero point six seven four.
每一轮误差约乘 0.454，正是 0.674 的平方。
A round costs two readings: calm, not speed. These facts apply existing results; the decimals are computed on screen.
一轮要读两次：平稳，不是更快。这些结论是既有结果的应用，小数是屏幕上算的。

scenes.name: ANGLE RULER
lines: Both settle at theta star, about forty-two point three degrees. Now climb toward ninety degrees.
两人都锁在 θ* ≈ 42.3°。现在朝 90° 攀升。
On the outside angle ruler, every step adds the same twenty-nine point two degrees.
在外部角度尺上，每一步都加上同样的 29.2°。
The second step already passes ninety. The cosine, the axial anchor, is zero, and the walk starts over.
第二步就越过了 90°：余弦，也就是轴向锚点，归零，只好从 0 重走一圈。

scenes.name: RAPIDITY
lines: Measure each step against the anchor that is left: d eta equals d theta over cosine theta.
改用剩下的锚点来量每一步：dη = dθ / cos θ。
Integrated, sine theta is the hyperbolic tangent of eta, and cosine theta is its hyperbolic secant.
积分之后，sin θ = tanh η，cos θ = sech η。
Theta star sits at eta zero point eight one seven. Ninety degrees sits at infinity.
θ* 落在 η ≈ 0.817；90° 落在无穷远。

scenes.name: STAIRCASE
lines: Now take equal steps of one in eta, starting from theta star.
现在从 θ* 出发，在 η 上等步走，每步 Δη = 1。
The angle climbs: forty-two, seventy-one and a half, eighty-three, eighty-seven and a half, crowding toward the wall.
The cosine is the secant of eta, positive at every finite step.
cos θ = sech η，对每一个有限步都严格为正。
After eight steps, the gap, one minus tanh eta, is four point four times ten to the minus eight. It is still open.
走到第 8 步，缝 1 − tanh η₈ ≈ 4.4 × 10⁻⁸，依然张开。

scenes.name: UNIT CIRCLE
lines: The same edge appears in the complex plane, under w equals s minus one, over s.
复平面上也有同样的边：w = (s − 1)/s。
Each line where the real part of s is a fixed c becomes a circle that touches the unit circle at w equals one.
实部固定为 c 的直线，变成一个在 w = 1 处与单位圆相切的圆。
Lean has checked it: the modulus is exactly one when, and only when, the real part is one half.
这一条已由 Lean 内核检验：模长恰为 1，当且仅当实部等于 ½。
So no c above one half reaches the unit circle, and the far gap, two minus one over c, stays open.
所以大于 ½ 的 c 都碰不到单位圆，远端的缝 2 − 1/c 依然张开。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, part nine, chapters thirty-three to thirty-six.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第九部 · 第三十三至三十六章
